architecture: V6 dual branch central-QRS/full-window; GlobalAveragePooling in both branches; no Flatten

group_balance.MITBIH: record_id proxy because full patient identity is unavailable
group_balance.method: inverse square-root group count within class, normalized to mean 1 per class

development_partition: reuse exact V6 checkpoint/threshold patient-record groups

threshold_selection.eligible: combined recall >= 0.95 and per-dataset recall >= 0.90 on threshold groups
threshold_selection.objective: maximum combined F1; tie higher precision then higher threshold
threshold_selection.fallback: maximum combined F1 if no eligible threshold

test_use: forbidden during V8 training, checkpoint selection, threshold calibration, and development comparison
